name: The Audio DB
tagline: Music metadata API for artists, albums, tracks, and music videos
description: The Audio DB (theaudiodb.com) is a community-oriented music metadata API providing structured data on artists, albums, tracks, music videos, and related media. Developers can look up discographies, biographies, artwork, and genre information for music catalog, media player, and discovery applications.

auth.details: API key as path segment in URL (e.g. /api/v1/json/{API_KEY}/search.php). Free test key 2 is commonly documented; paid/premium keys via signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free Music API (€0): public free test key; restricted methods/result counts on many V1 endpoints vs premium. Free rate limit 30 req/min. Premium unlocks fuller V1 methods and V2 API access.
pricing.paid_plans: Single Developer €8/month (premium V1 methods, higher limits, MusicBrainz lookups, music videos). Small Business €20/month (120 req/min, social links, dedicated support, private key). Lifetime options also listed on pricing page.

rate_limits: Free: 30 requests/minute; Premium: 100/minute; Business: 120/minute. Exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429; wait about one minute before retrying.
use_cases: look up artist biography and metadata by name
fetch album discography for an artist
get track listing for an album
retrieve music video links for an artist
search artists by genre or style for discovery UIs
